The TerraGroup information was useful, but still not enough to create a working antidote. However, I did find an important lead. The project to create this virus was highly classified, but Mechanic matched the virus codes with TerraGroup's internal division indexes. And we found an overlap. One of the key employees, not officially assigned to any open project, was a certain Vladimir O. I'm sure that a specialist of such importance kept everything important on his person, so as not to risk the spread of information. You need to thoroughly check the territory of the Laboratory, especially in the area of the block where the virus was developed. If my hunch is correct, you may find Vladimir's records there.}} ==Objectives== * Access the [[TerraGroup Labs residential unit keycard|sealed room]] with the virus in [[The Lab]] * Locate and obtain the [[V.O. signed diary|diary]] inside the [[TerraGroup Labs residential unit keycard|room]] * Hand over the found [[V.O. signed diary|item]] ==Rewards== * +30,000 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.03''' * 140,000 Roubles ** 147,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 161,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Violet)]] {{quote|Good! I'll get to work right away and contact Mechanic.
